column1: # Glow in the dark (research round 17, rec. 4; Planner 11-05): dim glowing plants, each with an _e mask from emissive.py. Approved by Ronald 11-05; the mushrooms renamed glow_mycena (Plants: real foxfire is the glowing threads, a mat to come). BLOCK_LIKE: mushroom_brown,reindeer_lichen,moss_block_top

column3: glow_mycena|plant|Glowing bonnet mushrooms (Mycena): a small cluster of five to seven tiny bioluminescent bonnet mushrooms (like Mycena) on thin pale stems, 10-14 px tall, standing at different heights from a little dark rotting-wood crumb at the bottom; the small bell-shaped caps pale grey-cream with a cool pale green tint (#7c8a6a #a8bc8c #cce0a8 #e4f2c8), the gills and cap edges a soft pale green, stems pale grey (#8a8c80 #b4b6a8), dark outline in a deep shade of its own colour, light from the top left
column4: glow_lichen|cutout|Glow lichen on a cave wall, seen flat: irregular crusty patches of pale grey-green lichen (#5e6a5a #7e8c78 #9cac94) covering about half the square in two or three blobs with ragged lobed edges, scattered with small round pale teal-green fruiting dots (#7ec8b4 #a8e4d0 #d0f6ec), the open parts magenta, light from the top left
column5: glow_crystal|plant|A small cluster of three to five pale crystal points growing up from a little rocky base, 12-16 px tall, six-sided pointed prisms leaning slightly apart; pale milky lilac-blue quartz (#6a6a8c #8c90b8 #b4bce0 #dce4f8) with one bright near-white facet each and a darker inner edge, the rocky base sage-grey stone (#4e5250 #707570), light from the top left
column6: glow_mycena_small|plant|Glowing bonnet mushrooms (Mycena), a smaller clump: two or three tiny bioluminescent bonnet mushrooms (like Mycena), 6-9 px tall, on a little crumb of dark rotting wood, the same pale grey-cream caps with a cool pale green tint (#7c8a6a #a8bc8c #cce0a8 #e4f2c8), pale grey stems, light from the top left
